artifact: Riplox Desktop 1.6.0 @ 30c2b8c (branch free-features-and-feed) - the change surface since v1.5.0

gates.why: auto-download needs BOTH the per-channel switch and watch_auto in Settings, and an upgraded 1.5.0 file has neither - the app refuses before _auto_download is reached
gates.tested_at: the two-switch guard itself, as its own case

gates.why: convert reads a file already on disk; it has no link at all
gates.tested_at: convert cases, which take a file rather than a link

mutation_checks.broke: the exclusive-create claim replaced by a plain create - two sweeps both take the file
network trouble spends a client rung again
the first read stops asking for one page

cases.name: bug-channel-timeout
cases.evidence: tests/test_youtube_speed_and_ladder.py - 'the first read asks for one page'

cases.name: bug-https-then-360p
cases.evidence: tests/test_youtube_speed_and_ladder.py - 'a broken connection is tried again on the same client'

cases.name: bug-slow-single-analyze
cases.evidence: tests/test_youtube_speed_and_ladder.py - 'a read somebody is waiting for does not' pause

cases.name: bug-quality-guard-narrow
cases.evidence: tests/test_youtube_speed_and_ladder.py - '4K asked, 720p given - now said too'

cases.name: bug-watch-hours-migration
cases.evidence: tests/test_following.py - "an older file's hours are read as minutes"

cases.name: bug-start-after-race
cases.evidence: tests/test_free_features.py - 'no worker started it in the gap while it was being queued'

cases.name: bug-probe-vanish
cases.evidence: tests/test_page_probe_and_drop.py - 'a link that was asked about and refused is still counted'

cases.name: bug-probe-second-door
cases.evidence: tests/test_page_probe_and_drop.py - the whole file runs with urlopen stubbed and no network

cases.name: bug-unknown-setting-dropped
cases.evidence: tests/test_defaults_that_bite.py - the new keys are in DEFAULT_SETTINGS

cases.name: seq-upgrade-then-follow
steps: start with a 1.5.0 settings.json and a 1.5.0 watch.json
load settings - the interval must come from watch_hours, not the default
load the watch list - every item must gain feed/opts/auto/full_checked
check one item - it must not announce the whole back catalogue
cases.evidence: casegrid runner - every settings=v150 + watchfile=v150_items case

cases.name: seq-drop-twice
steps: write a file of links into the drop folder
sweep - the links are queued and the file becomes .done
sweep again - nothing is queued a second time
cases.evidence: runner - 'a second sweep does not read it again'; tests - 'four sweeps at once queue each link exactly once'

cases.name: seq-convert-onto-itself
steps: take an mp4 already on disk
the original must still be there and the output must be a different file
cases.evidence: tests/test_free_features.py - 'a file is never converted on top of itself'

cases.name: seq-ladder-blip-then-refusal
steps: a download fails with a network error - the same client is tried again
it fails again with a refusal - now the ladder moves down
the rung that ran must be the second one, not the fourth
cases.evidence: runner trouble=network_blip and trouble=refused cases
